参照: (a) CNO Conf ltr Op-322V P16-3/QN, Serial 0442P32, dtd 4 November 1948

1. 参照文書(a)を情報通達および遵守のため以下に引用する:

「差出人: Chief of Naval Operations.
宛先: 全海軍地区司令官各位

件名: "Flying Discs" - Report of.

1. The Director of Intelligence, U.S. Air Force has informed
the Navy Department that a cycle of reappearance of "Flying Discs" is be-
coming apparent, and that the beginning of a new interval is imminent.
They have requested that any such sightings be reported as quickly as
possible, and that these phenomena be investigated.

2. It is requested, therefore, that all stations be directed
to report to the nearest Air Force Command and to the Naval District
Intelligence Office any reported sighting of "Flying Discs" or other
unidentified aerial objects. It is desired, also, that photographic
evidence of the phenomena be obtained whenever possible.

3. DIO's will forward such information to the Chief of Naval
Intelligence who will pass the information to the Director of Intelligence
U.S. Air Force by the fastest means.

s/ Thos. B. Inglis
THOS. B. INGLIS
By direction」

s/ R. C. Hudson
R. C. HUDSON
参謀長

summaryJa: 1948年12月13日付、第五海軍地区司令部からの回覧。第1参照文書は1948年11月4日付Chief of Naval Operationsの通達（Serial 0442P32）を引用しており、米空軍情報部が「飛行円盤」の再出現サイクルが明らかになりつつあり新たな区間の始まりが差し迫っていると報告したため、目撃情報は速やかに報告・調査するよう指示している。各基地は「飛行円盤」や未確認航空物体の目撃を最寄りの空軍指揮部および海軍地区情報部へ報告し、可能なら写真を取得すること。地区情報将校（DIO）は情報を海軍情報長官へ送付し、海軍情報長官が速やかに米空軍情報部長へ回送する旨。文書には配布先一覧（合計85部）と手書き注記、受領スタンプ（1948年12月15日）などの書類処理記録が含まれる。機密解除・ファイル番号などのヘッダ情報も記載。
summaryEn: Circular dated 13 December 1948 from the Commandant, Fifth Naval District. It quotes a Chief of Naval Operations letter (ref: Serial 0442P32, 4 November 1948) stating that the USAF Director of Intelligence reports a recurring cycle of "flying discs" with a new interval imminent, and requests prompt reporting and investigation of sightings. Stations are directed to report any sightings of "flying discs" or other unidentified aerial objects to the nearest Air Force Command and the Naval District Intelligence Office, and to obtain photographic evidence when possible. DIOs are to forward such information to the Chief of Naval Intelligence, who will relay it to the USAF Director of Intelligence by the fastest means. The file includes a distribution list (85 copies), handwritten annotations, clerical/received stamps (including 15 Dec 1948), and declassification/file header information.
